facts.fact: The guide recommends responding to every Google review, both positive and negative, within 24 hours.
facts.quote: Respond to every review, both positive and negative, within 24 hours.

facts.fact: The guide recommends posting on social media consistently 3-5 times per week.
facts.quote: Post consistently 3-5 times per week to stay familiar with your audience.

facts.fact: The guide recommends using Google Business Profile Posts weekly to announce promotions, news, or new products.
facts.quote: Use the "Posts" feature weekly to announce promotions, share news, or highlight new products.

facts.fact: The guide describes Google Business Profile as a free tool.
facts.quote: This free tool is your digital storefront on Google Search and Maps

facts.fact: The guide suggests geo-targeted Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns aimed at users within a few miles of the business.
facts.quote: run campaigns targeted specifically to users within a few miles of your business

facts.fact: The guide defines citations as mentions of a business's Name, Address, and Phone number (NAP) on directories.
facts.quote: Citations are mentions of your Name, Address, and Phone number (NAP)

facts.fact: The guide is titled '10 Essential Local Business Marketing Strategies for 2025'.
facts.quote: 10 Essential Local Business Marketing Strategies for 2025

facts.fact: The article's body describes its tactics as the most impactful for 2024 and beyond.
facts.quote: the 10 most impactful tactics for 2024 and beyond

facts.fact: The article page was published on 2025-11-24.
The page advises that businesses should never buy an email list and should instead collect emails ethically at point-of-sale, through website sign-up forms, or at local events.
facts.quote: Never buy an email list. Instead, collect emails ethically at your point-of-sale, through a sign-up form on your website

facts.fact: The page gives an example of a new boutique running Instagram ads targeting users within a 5-mile radius.
facts.quote: A new boutique can run Instagram ads targeting users within a 5-mile radius

facts.fact: The page recommends using radius targeting around a business address or targeting specific zip codes to limit ad spend to relevant local audiences.
facts.quote: Use features like radius targeting around your address or target specific zip codes

facts.fact: The page recommends using Google Trends filtered by city or state to discover popular local search topics.
facts.quote: Use tools like Google Trends (filtered by your city or state)

facts.fact: The page states that 93% of consumers say online reviews impact their buying choices, with no source cited.
facts.quote: because 93% of consumers say online reviews impact their buying choices.

facts.fact: The page recommends aiming to respond to all online reviews, positive and negative, within 48 hours.
facts.quote: Aim to respond to all reviews, positive and negative, within 48 hours.

facts.fact: The page recommends requesting a review a day or two after a purchase or service.
facts.quote: request a review a day or two after a purchase or service.

facts.fact: The page suggests that local micro-influencers with smaller, highly engaged followings fall in a range of 1,000 to 100,000 followers.
facts.quote: Start with creators who have smaller, highly engaged followings (1,000-100,000).

facts.fact: The guide says it explores ten distinct local business marketing strategies.
facts.quote: we've explored ten distinct yet interconnected **local business marketing strategies**

facts.fact: The guide's example influencer partnership deliverables are one Instagram post and three stories.
facts.quote: deliverables (e.g., one Instagram post, three stories)

facts.fact: The guide recommends giving each influencer a unique discount code or trackable link so campaign ROI can be measured.
facts.quote: Provide each influencer with a unique discount code or trackable link.

facts.fact: AdWave's guide claims that local advertising, including TV, can be more affordable per impression for local reach than national digital campaigns, though it gives no figures.
facts.quote: Local advertising, including TV, can be more affordable per impression for local reach than national digital campaigns.
